title: Czech officials warn of botulism in pate; more warnings issued in Salmonella outbreak traced to noodles
summary:
Public health officials in the Czech Republic have warned against eating a type of pate because of Clostridium botulinum contamination.

The alert was raised following a consumer complaint about health problems after consuming pork pate with almonds.

title: Europe sees rise in possible fraud alerts in June
summary:
Title: Europe sees rise in possible fraud alerts in June

URL Source: https://www.foodsafetynews.com/2026/08/europe-sees-rise-in-possible-fraud-alerts-in-june/

Published Time: 2026-08-04T04:00:49.000Z

Markdown Content:
Fifteen alerts mentioned the United States

![Image 1: Europe sees rise in possible fraud alerts in June](https://storage.ghost.io/c/43/4e/434e508a-5e2f-4102-a53d-00bca10bb4bf/content/images/size/w30/2026/07/food-fraud-adulteration-authenticity-1.png)

Published:August 04, 2026, 12:00 am

Suspected cases of fraud shared between European countries increased in June compared to the month before.

There were 215 reports in June, 150 in May, 188 in April, 204 in March, 159 in February, and 189 in January 2026. Earlier data for 2025 shows 196 in December, 194 in November, 223 in October,164 in September, 166 in August, 136 in July, 164 in June and 129 in May.

Fifteen alerts mentioned the United States in June. The majority were related to supplements but one was for additives in a carbonated soft drink not complying with EU limits and another was for illegal import of cheese sauce.

title: Hong Kong warns of severe infections caused by Vibrio
summary:
Health officials in Hong Kong have warned about a summer rise in a serious bacterial infection that can be caused by consumption of raw seafood or contact with seawater.

Vibrio vulnificus is present naturally in warm marine environments. Its concentration typically increases in summer when seawater temperatures rise.
